name: Honda Transmission Mfg. of America - Russells Point OH

fieldNotes.truckGate: Plant property is fully enclosed by chain-link fence with green privacy slats (confirmed in Street View from multiple headings along SR 235). A single managed driveway crosses the fence line from SR 235; entrance has lane markings and a covered island/canopy - controlled truck gate.
fieldNotes.guardShack: A small white booth-sized structure with an adjacent canopy island sits in the entrance driveway just inside the property line (z20 satellite). Consistent with a staffed guard booth at a Honda powertrain plant; classified true, flagged uncertain because Street View pano coverage stays on the public road and does not directly image the booth.
fieldNotes.postGateStaging: Wide internal paved aprons between the gate and the dock/trailer lots provide deep queuing room - drivewayLong = true.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Multiple organized trailer-parking rows east of the building with ~90 trailers visible across the drop lots - 25-50 band.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Dock lines with trailers backed in on the east and northeast building faces; ~40 doors estimated, flagged approximate.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Docks and trailer rows are concentrated along the east/northeast faces in one general cluster; no clearly separate second ship-vs-receive bank confirmed - false, flagged uncertain.
fieldNotes.railServed: No rail spur runs into the property.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Rural - plant sits amid farmland near Russells Point in Logan County, OH; no dense metro fabric.
fieldNotes.multipleFacilities: Single main transmission plant building with attached wings plus a few small support/storage buildings - treated as one facility cluster (long warehouse buildings west of SR 235 appear separate-use).
fieldNotes.siteAreaAcres: ~80 acres derived from the perimeter box; approximate.
